descr: Cuando llegué a mi casa, mis familiares me preguntaron por las gafas. Ya sabían que iba a participar en el proyecto, pero les surgieron dudas al verlas.
descr_english: When I arrived home, my family asked me about the glasses. They already knew I was going to take part in the project, but seeing them raised some questions.

descr: Una profesora de la Facultad de Medicina que desconocía el estudio, me pregunta por las gafas y su utilidad. Queda gratamente sorprendida.
future_use: No influirá en su uso futuro.
descr_english: A professor at the Faculty of Medicine who was not aware of the study asked me about the glasses and their purpose. She was pleasantly surprised.
future_use_english: It will not influence in it's future use.

descr: Vinieron unos amigos a mi casa y se sorprendieron cuando les recibí con las gafas puestas. Se interesaron mucho por el proyecto.
descr_english: Some friends came to my house and were surprised when I greeted them wearing the glasses. They became very interested in the project.
future_use_english: I don't think it will influence.
